spans.s:
mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
Immersed, drowned.
E.
प्र and मग्न plunged in.

mfn. (-नं)
Going, proceeding.
E.
प्र before मगि to go, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gone, proceeded.
E.
प्र before मगि to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Joyful, cheerful.
E.
प्र implying pleasure, and मनस् the mind; also प्रमनस्, न being optionally changed to ण.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Careless, negligent.
2 Blundering, a blunderer.
3

Intoxicated.
4

Insane.
E.
प्र before मत्त mad.

m. (-थः)
1 An attendant on Ś

IVA.
2

A horse.
f. (-था)
1 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
2 Pain, affliction.
E.
प्र excess, मथ to churn, (the enemies of ŚIVA,) aff. अच्.

Killing.
2

Paining, afflicting, torturing.
3 Violence.
E.
प्र before मथि to churn, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Killing, slaughter.
2 Paining, distressing.
3 Agitating, churning.
E.
प्र before मथ to churn, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-यं)
Hell.
E.
प्रमथ pain, and आलय an abode.

m. (-पः)
ŚIVA.
E.
प्रमथ a follower of ŚIVA, and अधिप master.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Well-churned.
2 Pained, distressed.
3 Trampled down.
n. (-तं)
Butter-milk without water.
E.
प्र before मथि to churn, क्त aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Mad, intoxicated, figuratively with passion or literally with liquor.
2

Violent.
3

Careless.
4

Impassioned.
m. (-दः)
1 Joy, pleasure, delight, rapture.
2 Datura, (D. metel.)
f. (-दा)
A woman, a handsome woman.
E.
प्र before मद mad, drunk.

m. (-दः)
1 Inadvertence, carelessness, error, inaccuracy.
3

Intoxication.
4

Insanity.
E.
प्र before मद to be mad, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
A royal garden or pleasure ground.
E.
प्रमद pleasure, and कानन a wood.

n. (-नं)
A royal garden.
E.
प्रमदा a woman, and कानन a wood: see the next.

n. (-नं)
A royal garden or pleasure ground attached to the Haram.
E.
प्रमद pleasure, and वन a wood.

n. (-नं)
A royal garden or pleasure ground attached especially to the private apartments of the palace.
E.
प्रमदा a woman, and वन a grove.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
Happy, delighted.
E.
प्र implying pleasure, and मनस् the mind.

mfn. (-न्युः-न्युः-न्यु)
Distressed, sorrowful.
E.
प्र, and मन्यु grief.

m. (-यः)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
प्र before मी to injure, aff. अच्.

f. (-मा)
1 True knowledge, or knowledge exempt from all error.
2 Consciousness, perception.
E.
प्र before मा to mete or measure, aff. अङ् and टाप्; that by which every object is measured or estimated.

n. (-णं)
1 Cause, motive.
2

Limit.
3

Proof, testimony, authority.
4 A scripture, a work of sacred authority.
5 Measure, quantity.
6 A speaker of the truth.
7 Always, eternal.
8 A title of VIṢṆ

Principal, capital.
E.
प्र before मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्; that by which all is measured; this word is generally restricted to the singular number, as वेदाः-प्रमाणं the Vedas are the authority; it is also confined to the neuter gender, as पुत्त्रः प्रमाणं the boy is a witness; some exceptions occur however, as प्रमाणः पुरुषः, प्रमाणा स्त्री the man witness, the woman witness; and in the following rule, प्रत्यक्षानुभानोपमानशब्दाः-प्रमाणानि perception, inference, comparison, and sound, are proofs.

ind.
1 According to proof or authority.
2 Agreeably to measure, to weight, &c.
E.
प्रमाण, and तसि aff.

m. (-षः)
An umpire, an arbitrator, a judge.
E.
प्रमाण, and पुरुष a man.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Receiving, admitting, or obeying, &c. as authority.
E.
प्रमाण, nominal v., शतृ aff.

m. (-वः)
Want or absence of proof or authority.
E.
प्रमाण, and अभाव non-existence.

f. (-का)
A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Exercising or proceeding from some evidence or authority, &c.
2 Being of authority.
m. (-कः)
1 A president, the chief or head of a trade, &c.
2 A learned man, one who supports his arguments by reference to books, &c.
E.
प्रमाण testimony, authority, aff. ठञ्.

n. (-णं)
Establishing or admitting as authority or proof.
E.
प्रमाण, and करण making, च्चि aug.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Admitted or established as proof or authority.
E.
प्रमाण, and कृत made, च्वि aug.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Proving, establishing.
E.
प्रमाण, and भूत become, च्वि aug.

m. (-हः)
A maternal great grandfather.
f. (-ही)
A maternal great grandmother.
E.
प्र before मातामह a grandfather.

mfn. (-ता-बी-तृ)
Proving, evidence, who or what is proof or authority.
E.
प्र before मा to measure, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-थी-थिनी-थि)
1 Afflicting, inflicting pain or sorrow.
2 Killing, destroying.
3 Breaking, cutting.
E.
प्र before मथ to churn, to grind, to pain, and घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Heedless, careless, incautious, inconsiderate, unreflecting.
2

Insane.
3

Intoxicated.
E.
प्रमाद carelessness, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-का)
1 An imprudent or careless woman.
2 A deflowered girl.
E.
प्र before मद to be careless, ण्वुल् aff., fem. form.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
1 Careless, indifferent.
2

Insane.
3

Intoxicated.
E.
प्र before मद to be inebriate, and घिनुण् aff.

Carelessness.
2

Insanity.
E.
प्र before मद to be mad, ण्यत् aff.

m. (-द्यः)
A tree, (Justicia adhenatoda.)
n. (-द्यं)
Madness, frenzy, fury, intoxication.
E.
प्र before मद to delight, aff. अच् and ण्यत् added.

ind.
From carelessness.
E.
प्रमाद्य, and तसि aff.

n. (-णं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
प्र before मीञ् to hurt or kill, पुक augment, from its taking the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.; the न of the affix also being unchanged, the word is written प्रमापन n. (-नं.)

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
Killing, destroying.
E.
प्र before मी to kill, causal v., णिनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Known, understood, established, proved.
2 Measured.
E.
प्र before मा to measure, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dead, deceased.
2 Immolated, sacrificed.
E.
प्र before मी to hurt or kill, aff. क्त.

f. (-रा)
A species of the Jagatī metre.

f. (-तिः)
1 True knowledge, or knowledge derived from the senses, inference, analogy or information.
2 Measuring.
E.
प्र before मा to measure, (by which,) क्तिन् aff., and radical vowel changed.

Thick.
2

Passed, passed as urine.
E.
प्र before मिह to sprinkle, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्)
1 Overcoming, subduing.
2 Injuring, killing.
E.
प्र before मी to hurt or kill, शतृ aff.

f. (-ला)
Lassitude, enervation, exhaustion from indolence or fatigue.
E.
प्र before मील to twinkle, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
1 Chief, principal.
2 Best, most excellent.
3 First.
m. (-खः)
1 A chief, a sage, any respectable man.
2 A heap, a multitude.
3 A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria.)
n. (-खं)
Time being, the present.
E.
प्र before मुख the face, &c.

n. (-त्वं)
Superiority, predominance.
E.
प्रमुख, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, प्रमुखता.

mfn. (-मुत्)
Pleased, happy.
E.
प्र before मुद to be pleased, क्विन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pleased, glad, content, happy.
E.
प्र excess, मुद to be pleased, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 A fool, foolish, stupid.
2 Bewildered, deceived.
E.
प्र, and मूढ a fool.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Bewildered, infatuated.
E.
प्रमूढ, and सज्ञा sign of sense.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Covered, concealed, withdrawn or gone out of sight.
2 Dead.
n. (-तं)
Tillage, cultivation.
E.
प्र before मृ to die, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Polished, bright, clear.
2 Rubbed.
E.
प्र before मृज to clean, or मृष to rub, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Greasy, unctuous.
2 Becoming or made unctuous.
E.
प्र before मिद to be unctuous, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Being or made unctuous.
E.
प्र before मिद to be unctuous, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Proveable, what may or ought to be proved.
2 Measurable, finite.
n. (-यं)
The thing to be proved. In logic, the second head, or topic, including twelve objects, as the soul, body, &c. or the form and end of existence.
E.
प्र before मा to measure, य aff.

m. (-हः)
Urinary affection, as change in the colour, quantity, or consistence of the urine; twenty-one varieties are enumerated, including diabetes, gonorrhœa, &c.
E.
प्र implying change, मिह to pass urine, with घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Liberating, setting free.
E.
प्र before मुच to liberate, ल्युट् aff.
f. (-नी)
A sort of cucumber: see गवाक्षी.
E.
प्र before मुच to loose, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-दः)
Pleasure, happiness, delight.
E.
प्र before मुद to be pleased, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Happy, delighted.
m. (-तः)
A name of KUVERA.
E.
प्रमोद happiness, इतच् aff.; or प्र before मुद to be happy, क्त aff., and the radical vowel changed.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
1 Happy, delighted.
2 Delighting, making happy.
E.
प्रमोद, and इनि aff.

Fascination.
2

Fainting, insensibility.
E.
प्र before मुह to be bewildered, घञ् aff.

f. (-चा)
One of the Apsaras, or nymphs of heaven.

n. (-ण्यं)
Authority, proof.
E.
प्रमाण, and ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-त्यं)
Debt.
E.
प्र and आङ् before मा to measure, क्यप् aff., and तुक aug.; also read प्राणीत्य.
